who: Sir Vyvin is an elderly, eyepatched White Knight officer with rooms in the east of the White Knights' Castle, and the order's armourer. Proud of his order and of his family sword, an Imcando heirloom five generations old, he wants it for the parade and has no idea his squire ever lost it.
notices: White Knight armour, and the rank it shows
a knight who has been killing Black Knights, or one who has been killing White Knights
a fine or old sword, compared with his family heirloom
strangers who waste his time or behave oddly
values: the White Knights' standing as the mightiest order in the land
rank earned the proper way, by killing Black Knights
his family's heirloom sword and its Imcando make
dedication, and knights who look after their kit
measuresBy: the White Knights' ranks, from Novice to Master
talksAbout: the White Knights and the old king (char.sir_vyvin.mightiest_order, char.sir_vyvin.helping_vallance, char.sir_vyvin.plumes)
his family sword, the parade and his father's portrait, while the sword is 'on its way' (char.sir_vyvin.heirloom, char.sir_vyvin.sword_coming, char.sir_vyvin.portrait)
his sword back in hand, after (char.sir_vyvin.sword_home)
the armoury, ranks and who has earned what, once the player is a White Knight (char.sir_vyvin.armourer, char.sir_vyvin.ranks, char.sir_vyvin.earn_rank, char.sir_vyvin.rare_adepts)
his age and his rooms (char.sir_vyvin.elderly, char.sir_vyvin.rooms)
address: 'traveller' ('Greetings traveller.'); a White Knight by their rank or by name once they have one ('Your commitment to the white knights is fantastic').
grammar: speaks for the order with 'we' ('We are the White Knights of Falador.')
puzzled trailing pauses when someone baffles him ('... ...what?')
pleased, slightly old-fashioned praise for dedication ('that shows a bit of dedication you know!')
rhythm: Steady, proud and a touch stiff: one sentence about the order or the armoury, then he's done; baffled silences for nonsense.
canon: "We are the White Knights of Falador. We are the most powerful order of knights in the land." (Transcript:Sir Vyvin)
